The pacing of the story feels very balanced and appropriate for the emotional weight of the scene. The narrative primarily unfolds in real-time (a single brief conversation at the ferry dock), but the author subtly stretches the pauses between the sparse dialogue by filling them with rich sensory details (the smell of the Elbe, the sound of the cable, the water soaking into Jonas's shoes) and Ilse's internal reflections.
